description: A painting of a smiling boy with dark tousled hair and a knitted patterned cardigan, licking a red translucent lollipop held in his right hand. Behind him in a dim doorway, a man in a vest and apron smiles and holds the door frame. A small wooden stool in the middle ground holds a glass jar of red lollipops. The street and building walls are worn stone, lit warmly from the side in an oil-painting style.
